content.title: Sidemen Charity Match 2026 Lineup: Wembley’s packed night and the missing stars
content.text: The sidemen charity match 2026 lineup arrives with the scale of a major stadium night and the feel of a reunion that has outgrown its own internet origins. On Saturday April 18 ET, Wembley Stadium in London will host the annual charity game, where 90, 000 fans are expected after a record sell-out in two-and-a-half hours. Brightside and M7 Education are the charities set to benefit, and the match will be streamed free on the Sidemen’s YouTube channel. For fans, the headline is simple: the stage is set, the squads are confirmed, and a few familiar faces will not be on it. What is the Sidemen Charity Match 2026 lineup? The sidemen charity match 2026 lineup pits Sidemen’s team against the YouTube Allstars, with Jack Joseph managing SDMN FC and Calfreezy taking charge of the YouTube Allstars. The Sidemen roster includes Zerkaa, Vikkstar, Wroetoshaw, TBJZL, Deji, Marlon, Arthur TV, AmineMaTue, ChrisMD, xQc, Adapt, Jynxzi, Niko Omilana, AB, AJ Shabeel, LazarBeam, and Lacy. Ad powered by advergic.com The YouTube Allstars side is led on the field by KSI, Miniminter, Behzinga, Angry Ginge, Stable Ronaldo, Squeezie, Mrwhosetheboss, JasonTheWeen, ItalianBach, Ibai, George Clarke, Danny Aarons, Chazza, CarryMinati, Sketch, WillNE, and Max Fosh. KSI said three Sidemen representatives have moved to the YouTube Allstars side to make the contest more competitive, naming himself, Simon, and Ethan among those switches. Why are Logan Paul and IShowSpeed missing? Two major names are absent from the confirmed lineups: Logan Paul and IShowSpeed. Their absence matters because both were part of last year’s most memorable moments, when the match ended 9-9 before the Sidemen lost on penalties after drawing a reported eight million live viewers and raising £4. 7 million for charity. For IShowSpeed, the reason is direct. Darren “IShowSpeed” Watkins Jr. is set to compete at Night 1 of WWE WrestleMania 42 in Las Vegas, where he is teaming with Logan Paul and Austin Theory in a six-man tag-team match against The Usos and LA Knight. The event is scheduled to begin at 6 p. m. ET, leaving little indication that a Wembley appearance is part of the plan. How can fans watch the match and what does it mean? Fans can watch the game for free through a live stream on the Sidemen’s YouTube channel, which has 23 million subscribers. That access matters because the match is no longer only about the crowd in the stadium; it is also about the millions watching from home and the money that follows their attention. The wider meaning is in the charities. Brightside and M7 Education will receive the profits from a match built around entertainment, but grounded in a clear purpose. That tension — between spectacle and service — is what gives the event its staying power. The sidemen charity match 2026 lineup may be packed with creators, but the night is ultimately measured by what it raises and who benefits. Ad powered by advergic.com At Wembley, the scale will be hard to ignore: a sold-out stadium, two reshuffled teams, and a free stream carrying the action beyond London. If the opening whistle brings back the same noise that filled the match last year, the closing scene may look familiar too — a crowd entertained, charities supported, and a live experiment in internet fame turned into something more tangible.
